LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.UpdateNotice.Title: Update log
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.Settings.NeverShowUpdateL: Stops the update log from opening automatically, including after future updates. Applies to all saves and remains enabled after restarting the game. You can still view the log manually below.
LanguageData.DreamsOutposts.Settings.OpenUpdateLog.De: Shows what changed in each released version of this mod.
